newsitem.title: USA: R.I. treasurer announced $24 mln in pension savings.
newsitem.headline: R.I. treasurer announced $24 mln in pension savings.

text.p: Rhode Island Treasurer Nancy Mayer on Wednesday announced $24 million in pension savings to state and local taxpayers next year as a result Wall Street's bull market.
The savings were made possible by three consecutive years of investment returns that were nearly double the assumed rate of 8 percent annually, Mayer said in a statement.
Rhode Island's public pension fund assets total exceed $5 billion.

Mayer, who heads the investment committee, said the savings were recognized on Wednesday after the state retirement board voted unanimously to fully recognize the investment gains as of June 30, 1996.
In fiscal year 1995, the pension fund's investment return was 16.3 percent and in FY 96, 15.8 percent. As of May 31, 1997 the investment return for the fiscal year was 15.14 percent, Mayer said.
